## What I Do

Sai Dutta Abhishek Dash builds at the intersection of three domains:

1. **Language AI for underserved markets** — Tokenizer optimization, LLMs, speech recognition, and translation for low-resource Indian languages. Building an Odia AI API (in development) and an Odia tokenizer for 38 million speakers.
2. **On-device security and measured AI infrastructure** — Local phishing detection, auto-refreshing security datasets, GPU benchmarks, and verification-gated fine-tuning workflows.
3. **Privacy-first infrastructure** — Zero-knowledge architectures, on-device processing, encrypted communication systems, and self-hosted platforms.

## Maelis Research

Maelis Research is a language AI venture founded in 2026, based in Dhenkanal, Odisha, building language AI infrastructure for Odia and other low-resource Indian languages.

**Why it exists:** 38 million people speak Odia. No commercial Odia-specific AI API existed before Maelis Research. For comparison, Norwegian (5M speakers), Greek (13M), and Dutch (25M) all have robust language AI support.

**What it is building:**

- **Odia tokenizer** — a Brahmic-script tokenizer for the Odia AI API
- **Lekhani** — Odia-exclusive LLM family in capability tiers (Pada, Chhanda, Kavya, Mahakavya)
- **Shruti** — Odia speech recognition and synthesis
- **Anuvada** — Odia translation with cultural context
- **odia-eval-benchmark** — 121,947 rows, 7 task families, 34 datasets, published on Hugging Face

Published artifacts carry their own licenses; see each repository or dataset card.
Website: https://maelis.in · Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/MaelisResearch

## Key Products

The 22 systems below span original tools, benchmarks, data pipelines, and agent skills.

### AI & Language Infrastructure

- **PhishScout** — On-device phishing detector paired with the PhishTrap phishing dataset pipeline. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/PhishScout)
- **MarkItDownJS** — Universal document-to-Markdown conversion engine for TypeScript. Converts PDFs, Office docs, images, audio, and archives into AI-ready Markdown. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/MarkItDownJS)
- **sysone-bench** — Independent byte-identical model benchmark for System One decision models, with 50 measurements, sealed manifests, and reproducibility tooling. (https://sysone.sdad.pro)
- **T4-Bench** — Tesla T4 LLM benchmark suite for inference, fine-tuning, image, video, and agent workloads. (https://t4b.sdad.pro)
- **Gupshup** — Gupshup Hinglish corpus of privacy-scrubbed code-mixed chat with 353,843 messages and deterministic splits. (https://huggingface.co/datasets/saidutta69/Gupshup)

### Security & Systems

- **Vulscany** — Private, self-hostable AI code security agent with automated fix generation and real-time CVE matching. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/vulscany)
- **PraharShield** — Minecraft Velocity anti-bot filter with CAPTCHA handshakes and client fingerprinting. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/PraharShield)
- **DadGuard** — Lightweight Windows security watchdog for non-technical users. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/DadGuard)
